scraped.title: Lockdown Studios | Websites That Turn Visitors Into Leads
scraped.description: Conversion-focused websites for service businesses that need clearer leads.

h1: Websites That Turn Visitors Into Leads

scraped.content: Lockdown Studios builds conversion-focused websites for local service businesses. The page shows a clear offer, visible proof, and a practical call booking path. It still needs a sharper mobile CTA and stronger before-after examples.
scraped.contentSnippet: Lockdown Studios builds conversion-focused websites for local service businesses. The page shows a clear offer, visible proof, and a practical call booking path.

findings: Primary CTA is visible but could use stronger contrast on mobile.
evidence: Desktop and mobile samples show clear hierarchy above the fold.

visualDesign.label: Strong
visualDesign.summary: The visible structure, readability, and polish are directionally strong.
factors: Visual audit base: CTA 72/100, readability 81/100, hierarchy 74/100, consistency 78/100.

findings: Offer is clear but the mobile CTA should be more prominent.
Proof exists, but before-after examples should move higher.
evidence: CTA signals found: book a call, request a quote.
Trust signals found: case studies, testimonials, before and after.

penalties.label: Mobile CTA
penalties.reason: Mobile users need a stronger next-step path.

scoring.singleBiggestLeak: The mobile visitor needs a clearer next step before scrolling.

roast.first_impression: This site has a real offer and enough proof to feel credible, but the lead path can be sharper on mobile.
roast.single_biggest_leak: The mobile CTA is not doing enough work above the fold.
mistakes: The strongest proof is lower than it should be.
The first CTA could be more specific than a generic booking prompt.
Before-after evidence is mentioned but not framed as a conversion story.
roast.lost_customers: Warm visitors may understand the service but delay action because the proof and next step do not appear together quickly enough.
quick_fixes: Move one before-after result into the first screen.
Change the primary CTA to Book a 15-minute website review.
Add one short client outcome beside the booking button.
roast.high_impact: Pair the CTA with one proof point above the fold so visitors can trust and act in the same moment.

claim_contract.claim: The site has a clear offer.
claim_contract.evidence: Websites That Turn Visitors Into Leads
